description: UX Bug Fixes Sprint - Fix delete confirmation, navigation display, progress indication, modal close, and language selection

userStories.title: Delete confirmation modal dialog
userStories.description: As a user, I want to confirm before deleting a book so that I don't accidentally delete data.
acceptanceCriteria: Click Delete button shows confirmation modal
Modal content: 'Confirm delete {book name}? This cannot be undone.'
Cancel button closes modal without deleting
Confirm Delete button executes deletion
Clicking outside modal does not trigger delete
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Navigation dropdown expands
userStories.description: As a user, I want the chapter navigation dropdown to expand so I can select chapters.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking dropdown shows chapter list (5 options visible)
Dropdown arrow changes direction when expanded
Selecting chapter navigates and closes dropdown
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Display correct chapter title
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the actual chapter title instead of 'Unknown'.
acceptanceCriteria: Entering book shows first chapter title correctly
Navigating chapters updates title display
Title shows chapter number and name (e.g., '1. Introduction to DeepSeek')
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Previous/Next buttons work correctly
userStories.description: As a user, I want Previous/Next buttons to navigate chapters properly.
acceptanceCriteria: Previous button enabled when not on first chapter
Next button enabled when not on last chapter
Clicking Previous navigates to previous chapter
Clicking Next navigates to next chapter
First/last chapter disables corresponding button
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Concept Graph button shows feedback
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Concept Graph button to show feedback when clicked.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Concept Graph button switches to graph view
Active button has visual highlight (border or background change)
Current view is clearly indicated
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Extract button shows progress indicator
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see progress when extracting concepts so I know the system is working.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Extract shows spinner animation
Status text 'Extracting concepts...' is displayed
Progress indicator disappears when extraction completes
Error message shown if extraction fails
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Core Concepts modal closes with Escape
userStories.description: As a user, I want to close the Core Concepts modal with Escape key.
acceptanceCriteria: Pressing Escape while modal is open closes it
Close has appropriate transition animation
Focus returns to trigger button after close
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Upload language selection has description
userStories.description: As a user, I want to understand the language selection meaning.
acceptanceCriteria: Language dropdown has clear option labels
Help text explains: 'Select language for concept extraction'
Auto-detect option is selected by default
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
